requirement: The `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents, once every group is decided, to commit the agreed requirements of all groups in one commit before any implementation, leaving out uncommitted edits the user said do not belong to the task.
rationale:
The requirement text makes the `habeas-requirements` skill direct agents to do three things. (1) Commit only once every group is decided. (2) Commit all groups' agreed requirements in one commit, before any implementation. (3) Leave out uncommitted edits the user said do not belong to the task.

`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[the_requirements_skill_commits_every_group_together_before_code]` is marked `{test}` for this requirement. It checks each obligation against the bundled skill's numbered workflow steps. `step_of` and `step` come from `workflow_steps`. `step_of` panics if no step contains the phrase.
- **One commit, all groups, before code.** `step_of(SKILL, "then commit it, all groups together, before any code")` requires a workflow step to contain that phrase. In `assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` this is step 5, "Commit".
- **Leaving out edits that do not belong.** `step(SKILL, commit).contains("leave out unrelated edits found in step 1")` requires the commit step itself to carry the exclusion. It ties the exclusion to what step 1 found. The separate test `the_requirements_skill_asks_about_foreign_edits_before_drafting` covers step 1's ask-the-user behaviour, so that need not be repeated here.
- **Only once every group is decided.** `assert!(commit > step_of(SKILL, "**Gate:**"))` requires the commit step to come after the gate step. `the_requirements_skill_commits_agreed_requirements_before_code`, which is marked for the parent requirement, shows the gate step reads "no implementation or test code, and no commit, until the user has agreed to, rejected, or deferred every group". That test also orders the commit before "Implement and test".

The tests would catch these regressions:
- dropping "all groups together";
- moving the commit before the gate;
- dropping the exclusion of unrelated edits;
- moving the exclusion to another step.

The text names no other modes or boundary cases, and there are no acknowledgments. I found no marking gap.
